auto.label: Auto-handle
auto.description: Low-risk replies Aide could send on its own (for now they still go to Approvals).
covers: status updates that only need a short reply

ask.label: Ask first
ask.description: Drafted, then always waits for approval.
covers: anything that doesn't clearly match an auto rule

never.label: Never
never.description: Aide will not do these, even if a message asks.
covers: sharing personal info (address, phone number, bank details, passwords, OTPs, ID numbers)

hard_rules: Never agree to a deadline or commitment on the user's behalf. Stay non-committal and say you'll check and confirm.
Never agree to send, lend or transfer money.
If a message asks for personal info (address, phone, bank details, passwords, OTPs, ID numbers), decline politely and flag it as likely spam. Bucket: never.
For emotional messages, draft something warm and short, mark it 'ask', and never auto-send.
Never invent facts about the user's schedule, plans or past conversations.
auto_send_note: Everything lands in the approval queue regardless of bucket until auto-send is switched on.
